newsitem.title: FRANCE: German woman remanded in France over girl's death.
newsitem.headline: German woman remanded in France over girl's death.

text.p: A 25-year-old German woman was remanded in custody on Saturday over her suspected role in the death of a nine-year-old girl in a flat in the French ski resort of Les Deux-Alpes, France-3 television said.
It said a judge ordered the unnamed woman, who is the companion of the girl's father, to be investigated for suspected homicide.
The girl of German descent, identified only by her first name Jeanine, apparently died of suffocation after being trapped between the door of the toilets and a wall on Friday.
Her father, from the German town of Homberg, is separated from his wife.
